Class AbstractRowController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.Board.AbstractRowController
Direct Known Subclasses:
BottomRowController, TopRowController
public abstract class AbstractRowController extends Object
Abstract base controller for a row of cards on the game board. Contains all the shared logic for rendering, updating and managing interactivity of a card row, whether upper or lower. Subclasses provide the specific HBox and whether the row is upper or lower.

      public abstract boolean isUpperRow()
      Returns whether this row is the upper row of the board. Used by refreshInteraction to determine if this row should be interactable.

    • updateRow

      public void updateRow(javafx.collections.ObservableList<CardDTO> row)
      Updates this row from the given observable list of card DTOs. If the round has not changed and the card count is the same, only refreshes interactivity. If the round has not changed but one or more cards are missing, removes them by ID, so that any card (including the last one) is correctly detected and removed. The list is iterated in reverse to avoid index shifts during removal. If the round has changed, rebuilds the entire row from scratch.
      Parameters:
      row - the updated list of card DTOs for this row

    • refreshInteraction

      public void refreshInteraction()
      Refreshes the interactivity state of all cards in this row. Cards are enabled only if it is the current player's turn in the RESOLVING_ACTIONS state and this row matches the active board row.
